purpose: Teach: オリックス/テレビ朝日/スズキ/男優/ソビエト/ケニア/司馬/ブルジョアジー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、オリックスのファンクラブだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, our customer has a fan club membership with the Orix baseball team.
lines.style: Warm, almost amused observation. Sharing a detail like a small secret. Soft, admiring tone. Pace unhurried—she's savoring the quirk of it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、テレビ朝日の番組制作をされてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, our customer produces programs for TV Asahi.
lines.style: Thoughtful, as if piecing together a picture. Slight lift of interest on the job title. Quiet wonder in the delivery. She's genuinely impressed but not overdoing it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、スズキの軽自動車に乗ってお越しになったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, our customer drove here in a Suzuki kei car.
lines.style: Gentle noticing of a small, human detail. The kind of thing Mei would catch and find endearing. Soft, almost wistful—grounded simplicity.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご主人が男優として活躍されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, our customer's husband is an actor.
lines.style: Straightforward statement with a note of respect. Delivered clearly but without fanfare. Pause before the reveal—letting it land naturally.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、旧ソビエト連邦の研究をされてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, our customer does research on the Soviet Union.
lines.style: Curious, almost wondering how that life led here. Slight hesitation—the specificity is interesting to her. Warm, appreciative of the intellect.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ケニアでマラソンの合宿されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, our customer did a marathon training camp in Kenya.
lines.style: Impressed, but held quiet. Slight lift on the destination—Kenya carries weight. She's admiring the ambition without making it loud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、司馬遼太郎の小説を全巻お持ちだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, our customer owns the complete collection of Shiba Ryotaro novels.
lines.style: Reverent, almost. The kind of dedication that moves Mei. Slow, thoughtful pace. Deep respect for that kind of commitment to a writer.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ブルジョアジー研究の経済学者だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, our customer is an economist who specializes in bourgeoisie studies.
lines.style: Final piece falling into place. Satisfied recognition—the intellect, the depth. Delivered with quiet certainty, almost a completion. Warm close.
